claims.claim_text: Kratos describes itself as a leading provider of target drone / aerial target systems to the U.S. Air Force and Navy, with target drone programs and rocket system programs flagged as having been delayed by COVID-19. This implicates the Air Force Aerial Targets program (BQM-167 / Subscale Aerial Target / SSAT) and Navy SSAT (BQM-177A) as material revenue streams.
claims.subject: Kratos Unmanned Systems / Kratos Unmanned Aerial Systems
claims.object_value: Air Force Aerial Targets program (BQM-167 SSAT) and Navy Subsonic Aerial Target (BQM-177A)
claims.source_quote: COVID-19 customer and contractor-related travel and social distancing restrictions have delayed a number of our target drone, tactical drone and rocket system programs, missions and exercises... unmanned aerial drone, unmanned ground, unmanned seaborne systems and artificial intelligence.

claims.claim_text: Kratos lists Unmanned Combat Aerial System (UCAS) contract wins from its investment in high-performance UADS platforms as a forward-looking competitive position. This is the XQ-58 Valkyrie / Skyborg / Collaborative Combat Aircraft narrative — the high-multiple growth story for the Unmanned Systems segment.
claims.subject: Kratos Unmanned Systems segment
claims.object_value: Unmanned Combat Aerial System (UCAS) program-of-record contracts — XQ-58 Valkyrie / Skyborg / CCA
claims.source_quote: our significant investment in high-performance Unmanned Aerial Drone System ( UADS ) platforms and technology, which has culminated in a series of Unmanned Combat Aerial System ( UCAS ) contract wins.

claims.claim_text: Kratos lists 'Ballistic missile defense and hypersonic systems' and 'rocket, hypersonic and missile defense systems' among its primary focus areas, positioning the company in hypersonic-prototyping and BMD spend. KGS includes a defense and rocket support services operating segment.
claims.subject: Kratos Government Solutions / Defense & Rocket Support Services
claims.object_value: Hypersonics Prototyping (PE 0604033F) / Ballistic Missile Defense programs
claims.source_quote: Kratos primary focus areas are unmanned systems, space and satellite communications, microwave electronics, cybersecurity/warfare, rocket, hypersonic and missile defense systems, turbine technologies... Ballistic missile defense and hypersonic systems.

claims.claim_text: Kratos states it is well-positioned to capitalize on DoD space and national-security space investments, with space & satellite ground segment command/control, radio frequency interference monitoring, geolocation, and mitigation products. This anchors space-domain revenue against Satellite Control Network and adjacent SF/Space Force PEs.
claims.subject: Kratos space & satellite division (incl. Cosmic acquisition)
claims.source_quote: with our space & satellite and terrestrial ground segment command, control, radio frequency interference monitoring, geolocation and mitigation products and capabilities, we believe we are well-positioned to capitalize on the DoD budget for space investments, a significant portion of which is for the development and protection of U.S. national security space assets and infrastructure.

claims.claim_text: Kratos identifies C5ISR systems, including 'Strategic Deterrence Systems' as a primary capability, implying exposure to ICBM modernization (Sentinel/GBSD) and worldwide joint strategic communications support.
claims.subject: Kratos C5ISR / Strategic Deterrence Systems
claims.object_value: ICBM / Strategic Deterrence PEs (Minuteman, Worldwide Joint Strategic Communications)
claims.source_quote: C5ISR systems, including Strategic Deterrence Systems.

claims.claim_text: 70% of FY2021 total revenue came from contracts with the U.S. Government (prime or sub). This is a DoD-customer-concentration disclosure that the J-Book/usaspending pair can cross-validate.
claims.subject: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions
claims.object_value: U.S. Government (incl. DoD/FMS): 70% of FY2021 revenue
claims.source_quote: In fiscal 2021, 2020 and 2019, we generated 70%, 73% and 71%, respectively, of our total revenues from contracts with the U.S. Government (including all branches of the U.S. military and including FMS), either as a prime contractor or a subcontractor.

claims.claim_text: Remaining performance obligations of $953.9M at Dec 26, 2021; 51% expected to be recognized as revenue in FY2022, 19% in FY2023, balance thereafter. This is a forward-looking backlog claim tied to existing DoD contracts.
claims.subject: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions
claims.object_value: $953.9M remaining performance obligations as of Dec 26, 2021
claims.source_quote: On December 26, 2021, the Company had approximately $953.9 million of remaining performance obligations. The Company expects to recognize approximately 51.0% of the remaining performance obligations as revenue in 2022, an additional 19.0% in 2023, and the balance thereafter.

claims.claim_text: KTT Division (Florida Turbine Technologies) is focused on small, affordable, high-performance jet engines for the next generation of tactical weapon systems and tactical jet UAS — a forward narrative that ties to Advanced Engine Development / propulsion PEs.
claims.subject: Kratos KTT Division (acquired Feb 2019)
claims.object_value: Small turbojet engines for tactical weapons / tactical UAS — Advanced Engine Development (PE 0604004F)
claims.source_quote: FTT is now the KTT Division, which is focused on the development and production of small, affordable, high-performance jet engines for the next generation of tactical weapon systems and tactical jet UAS.

claims.claim_text: Subsequent-events disclosure: Cosmic Advanced Engineering Solutions acquired Dec 27, 2021 for $37.5M cash; Cosmic provides 'overhead persistent infrared for missile defense systems' (OPIR) and 'radio frequency, terrestrial, and space-based communication solutions, including digital signals processing and geolocation analysis.' This ties to Next Generation OPIR (PE 1206442SF) exposure.
claims.subject: Kratos Integral Holdings / Cosmic (acquired Dec 27, 2021)
claims.object_value: Next Generation OPIR (PE 1206442SF) / missile-warning space programs
claims.source_quote: Cosmic focuses on radio frequency, terrestrial, and space-based communication solutions, including digital signals processing and geolocation analysis. In addition, Cosmic provides overhead persistent infrared for missile defense systems and embedded cyber solutions to U.S. government agencies.

claims.claim_text: Kratos owned/leased ~1.3M sq ft of floor space at 50 separate locations as of Dec 26, 2021, including 98 acres in Ontario, Canada used by CPI ASC Signal Division. Non-J-Book control claim (facility footprint).
claims.subject: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions
claims.object_value: ~1.3M sq ft across 50 locations; major locations: Huntsville AL, San Diego CA, Sacramento CA, Colorado Springs CO, Oklahoma City OK, Round Rock TX
claims.source_quote: At December 26, 2021, we owned or leased approximately 1.3 million square feet of floor space at 50 separate locations, primarily in the U.S., for manufacturing, warehousing, research and development, administration and various other uses.

claims.claim_text: Kratos refinanced its capital structure on Feb 18, 2022: redeemed $300M 6.5% Senior Secured Notes and replaced with $200M Term Loan A + $200M Revolver (5-year), expecting ~$10-13M/yr in interest savings. Non-J-Book control claim (capital structure).
claims.subject: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions
claims.object_value: $300M 6.5% Senior Secured Notes redeemed; new $200M TLA + $200M revolver
claims.source_quote: On February 18, 2022, the Company completed the refinancing of its outstanding $90 million revolving credit facility and $300 million 6.5% Senior Secured Notes, with a new 5-year $200 million Revolving Credit Facility and 5-year $200 million Term Loan A... the Company expects to save approximately $10 to $13 million in cash interest payments annually.

args.query: Kratos Defense Senior Secured Notes redemption
